reasons: The claimed status is compliant and the redline is identical to the original paragraphs with no comment, which is exactly what a compliant finding should look like.

The AUDIT rule constrains audit/inspection rights exercisable against the Customer; the cited text (invoice supporting detail owed by Contractor to Company, and a license grant to Company) contains no Contractor right to audit, inspect or verify Company usage, so the absence of any such right is better than the preferred position and operates in our favour.

The failed deterministic check ('audit frequency limited') is an artefact of there being no audit clause to match rather than evidence of a deviation; no frequency, notice, cost or system-access term binds us.

Rationale is accurate and appropriately notes that any later Statement of Work introducing a verification right would need the preferred limits, so the finding is useful internal evidence without over-flagging.
